name: College of Creation
summary: Bards who sing the Song of Creation and bring objects to life.

features.name: Mote of Potential
features.short: Your inspiration dice gain extra effects.
features.summary: When you give Bardic Inspiration, a mote of potential orbits the creature. On an ability check it rolls the die twice; on an attack it deals thunder damage around the target; on a save it gains temporary hit points.

features.name: Performance of Creation
features.short: Action: create a non-magical item from nothing.
features.summary: As an action, you create a nonmagical item worth up to 20 x your bard level gp, of a size based on your level. It lasts a number of hours equal to your PB. Once per long rest (or by spending a 2nd-level slot).

features.name: Animating Performance
features.short: Animate a Large or smaller object as a dancing ally.
features.summary: As an action, you animate a Large or smaller nonmagical item for 1 hour. It obeys you, acts on your turn and can use Irrepressible Dance to slow or speed creatures. Once per long rest (or by spending a 3rd-level slot).

features.name: Creative Crescendo
features.short: Create several items at once, of any size.
features.summary: When you use Performance of Creation, you can create up to CHA-modifier items at once, and there is no gp limit for one of them.
